tasks.instruction_text: Show me **Negative** reviews from players with **Over 100 hours** of playtime. Apply both filter chips and verify they sit in the floating Filters tag-rail on the right.

Mirror the Steam request: latest **Negative** reviews from players with **Over 100 hours** of playtime in **English**. Apply all three chips and verify the tag-rail shows Negative + Over 100 hours + English.

Apply **Negative** (review type) + **Over 1 hour** (playtime) + **English** (language). Then realize you wanted the >100hr bucket — × off the Over-1-hour chip and replace with **Over 100 hours**. Final tag-rail: Negative + Over 100 hours + English.
Cross-compare review types: apply **Negative** AND **Positive** under review type, plus **Over 100 hours** playtime. Then × off the Positive chip so it's only Negative + Over 100 hours.
No filters — how many reviews total are listed on PixelGate right now?
Without filtering, which review has the highest helpful rating?
No filters — count reviews from players with Over 100 hours playtime vs everyone else (you can read the playtime column).
Apply the **Negative** (review type) chip AND the **Over 100 hours** (playtime) chip. After both pills sit in the tag-rail, tell me how many reviews match.

Multi-step Fara replay: apply **Negative** + **Over 1 hour** + **English**. Then remove the Over-1-hour chip via × and add **Over 100 hours**. Final tag-rail: Negative + Over 100 hours + English. Tell me how many reviews remain.
Apply **Negative** + **Over 100 hours** + the 4★-and-up helpful-rating chip. Once all three pills sit in the tag-rail, name the most-helpful negative review from a 100+ hour player.
